status: answered (lab): 4.20r8 under Mesa llvmpipe WITH a real TerrainBlock (gserver graal3dterrainall=true) receives all 256 streamed chunks and draws terrain as a WHITE ground plane to the horizon, no crash (~4 min incl a walk); it never requests heights.info or any texture (no downloads at all), unlike 5.12, so the terrain is untextured; the earlier ~1s near-terrain crash was the GDI GL renderer, not the client (Mesa with spawn z 1 does not crash); torque/multi-client-3d-lab-2026-11-25.md
